title: Fix cycle detection and lexicographical tie-breaking in DAG scheduler
prompt:
Fix the bugs in `dag_sched/scheduler.py`:
1. `schedule(deps)` takes a dict mapping `task -> list of prerequisite tasks`. It must return a deterministic topological order using lexicographical (alphabetical) tie-breaking among all currently ready tasks (use a min-heap).
2. If a task depends on an unknown task (not a key in `deps`), raise `KeyError`.
3. If the dependency graph contains a cycle (including self-dependency), raise `ValueError`.
Run `pytest` and verify edge cases.
